backend/main.mo: Main actor defining the Nakshatra management system with user profiles, CRUD operations for 27 Nakshatras, image storage, access control (admin/user roles), and automatic migration seeding on first initialization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that seeds initial Nakshatra data (Ashwini and Bharani shown) with complete metadata including ruling deity, symbol, characteristics, lunar climate, karmic lesson, and four pada descriptions.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components, hooks, and utilities including routing, authentication, Nakshatra display/editing, astronomical calculations, and initialization-aware error handling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a cosmic aesthetic with purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, 'Star Field Explorer' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, Nakshatra detail, and admin pages (wrapped in AdminGuard), plus ThemeProvider for dark mode and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that shows PasscodeEntry if not authenticated, otherwise renders protected admin children components.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogoutButto: Logout button component that clears passcode auth, Internet Identity session, React Query cache, and shows success toast.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Expandable banner displaying current Moon Nakshatra with pada number, linking to detail page, and showing lunar climate description, karmic lesson, and pada-specific information when expanded.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link (including UTM parameters based on hostname) and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with Moon icon, 'Star Field Explorer' branding, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin sections with active state styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component that wraps the application with a header, footer, and main content area using React Router's Outlet for nested routes.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a responsive grid of Nakshatra cards with images, highlighting the current moon position, and showing loading states during backend initialization.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Image upload component that validates 4:5 aspect ratio, converts files to Uint8Array, displays preview, and handles upload progress with remove functionality.
frontend/src/components/PasscodeEntry.ts: Admin authentication form that validates a passcode and initiates Internet Identity login flow with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Hook that calculates and returns the current Nakshatra based on moon position, refreshing every 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: React Query mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data and images, with automatic cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasscodeAuth.ts: Authentication hook that validates admin passcode, manages session storage, triggers Internet Identity login, and syncs auth state across components via custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching Nakshatra data from the backend actor, including getAllNakshatras, readNakshatra by name, and getImage by ID. Implements error transformation, initialization error detection, and exponential backoff retry logic for canister availability issues.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark-themed design system, defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and chart elements in OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing a single Nakshatra's details including description, deity, symbol, characteristics, and pada information. Handles form state, image uploads, and mutation calls to update backend data with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying a grid of all Nakshatras with thumbnails and edit buttons. Shows initialization loading states, error alerts, and handles backend canister connection issues with retry functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page explaining Nakshatras and displaying the current Nakshatra banner plus a grid of all Nakshatras. Handles loading, initialization, and error states for backend data fetching.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for a single Nakshatra showing comprehensive information including description, deity, symbol, characteristics, and pada details in tabs. Merges backend data with fallback static data and displays current Nakshatra badge when applicable.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Defines Nakshatra data structures and implements astronomical calculations for determining Moon's position in Nakshatras, including Julian Day conversion and ecliptic longitude calculations based on Jean Meeus' algorithms.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Contains detailed descriptive data for each pada (quarter) of the Nakshatras, including degree ranges, Navamsa signs, titles, and extensive psychological/astrological descriptions for interpretation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing with persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and integrating typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a backend initialization bug where Nakshatra data is unavailable, with six pending architectural requirements focused on fixing data seeding, migration logic, and initialization error handling.
